name: NZ 8 m Digital Elevation Model (2012), Geographx
description: National 8 m raster elevation model built by Geographx mainly from LINZ Topo50 20 m contour data.
story: The national 8 m digital elevation model was originally created by Geographx, founded by Roger Smith, using mainly the January 2012 LINZ Topo50 contour dataset with additional processing around coasts and water bodies.

It became one of the most heavily downloaded national elevation layers distributed through LINZ. LINZ describes this contour-derived model as suitable for cartographic visualisation, not for detailed terrain analysis; its 8 m grid spacing does not imply 8 m source accuracy or LiDAR survey precision.
